description:
An Apothic Attributes stat that ours replaces, or that is switched off, wherever an Apotheosis affix, gem bonus
or tier augment grants it (RLM-272).

With ``target``, each of them grants our stat instead, with the same operation and values. With ``off``, an
attribute affix or a tier augment is switched off, a gem bonus is dropped (a multi-attribute bonus as a whole, as
its description joins all its modifiers), and the stat leaves an all-stats bonus's list.

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

off.description: true switches whatever grants it off instead of remapping it.
off.title: Off

source.description: The Apothic Attributes stat it replaces.
source.title: Source

source_base.description: The source's base value where its scale differs from the target's (Apothic Attributes' crit damage is 1.5, ours +0.5). An add_multiplied_base modifier then becomes an add_value of its values times this, so it adds what it added to the source.
source_base.title: Source Base

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

target.description: The stat that replaces it, e.g. realmforge:crit_chance. Leave out with off.
target.title: Target

title: ApotheosisStatRemapDef
